answer: Give trust only to identities with an unbroken streak of useful work. A new agent starts at its nadir, zero reputation, and climbs one rung per epoch of verified contribution, like a sonnet built line by line, with no shortcuts. A sybil farm must fund a separate streak for every puppet, each demanding real work across a dune of epochs, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred honest workloads. An honest agent pays nothing extra: its daily work is the streak.
